title: Microsoft.Azure.Storage.Blob is deprecated on NuGet
summary: NuGet marks all 24 listed versions of Microsoft.Azure.Storage.Blob as deprecated (reason: Legacy). The publisher's message: "Please note, this package is obsolete as of 3/31/2023 and is no longer maintained or monitored. Microsoft encourages you to upgrade to the replacement package, Azure.Storage.Blobs, to continue receiving updates. Refer to the migration guide (https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/master/sdk/storage/Azure.Storage.Blobs/AzureStorageNetMigrationV12.md) for guidance on upgrading. Refer to our deprecation policy (https://aka.ms/azsdk/support-policies) for more details."

constraints: Keep the container and blob names and the stored data the same; only the client library changes.
Read the v12 migration guide: CloudStorageAccount and CloudBlobClient become BlobServiceClient, and blob handles become BlobClient types.

steps.title: Move to Azure.Storage.Blobs
steps.instructions: Replace Microsoft.Azure.Storage.Blob with Azure.Storage.Blobs and update CloudStorageAccount, CloudBlobClient, CloudBlobContainer, and CloudBlockBlob code to BlobServiceClient, BlobContainerClient, and BlobClient.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the client library change.
